quest.title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas: Soliloquy of Distant Island Peaks
quest.description: You agreed to Ioroi's request to "bring Kichiboushi out to train." Time to head to Guyun Stone Forest this time.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Different from snow mountain. Not cold. No snow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is Guyun Stone Forest! Legend has it that this is where Rex Lapis defeated that, uh, many-headed water snake thingamabob — what was its name again?

choices.text: The Overlord of the Vortex?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right, that's the one! Osial, the Overlord of the Vortex! This is where it was defeated by Rex Lapis' stone spears and sealed.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Ooh!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cool, eh? But we fought with it too, y'know? Atop Ningguang's Jade Chamber...

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Golden Crystalfly!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so that was what you were gushing over? C'mon, Paimon's telling a story over here!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, it does look different from the ones in Inazuma...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: He's probably never seen a Crystalfly that wasn't purple...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well... Guess that's true. Alright, alright. Why don't you catch one for him, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: And you're not gonna do it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you've got more experience at this.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It can be done, but we can only capture its Crystal Core.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Yey! Nice!

choices.text: But you're the one who can fly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: True, but you've got more experience at catching 'em!

choices.text: Alright.
Osial?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Kapow~ Crystalfly~ Golden Crystalfly!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Not gold.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? The Crystal Core really isn't golden!

choices.text: Well, you both say that, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come to think of it, Paimon's never really noticed this even though you've caught lots of Crystalflies in the past...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Is this what they call "disillusionment"? You know, the thing that happens when you get older?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Looks like you're in need of some training yourself, Paimon.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: White Fur, can do it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't you "you can do it" Paimon! You're the one who's training, Kichiboushi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, it is kinda disappointing. Why are the Crystal Cores of Geo Crystalflies not gold?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Right. Gold Crystalfly, why not gold?

choices.text: Crystalflies might just be that kind of organism.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh well, then. In any case, let's proceed as we planned. Time to take Kichiboushi to see The Alcor!

choices.text: I honestly don't know the answer to that question.
There's not much I can do about it.

talks.objective: Go to a place from which you can see The Alcor

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See The Alcor!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Amazing! So much water!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: And so big! So big, on the water!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: So big, must be heavy. Why not sinking?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's because The Alcor is a ship.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: But, mud boat sink. Ioroi tell story. Story of rabbit, bake-danuki, and the mud boat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, well, The Alcor isn't made of mud. That's why it won't sink.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Why will not-mud ship not sink?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, you're becoming more fluent, Kichiboushi. But at the same time, how are we supposed to answer this question...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Right! Hehe, {NICKNAME}, why do ships float on the water's surface?

choices.text: Ships are made of wood. All hail the power of Dendro!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Can Dendro really do that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... Then why don't hilichurls with wooden shields float?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mmmph. Didn't get it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, Kichiboushi. Someday, when you're older, you'll be as smart as Paimon! Then you'll understand all these things: why ships float, why it snows in Dragonspine... You'll know it all!

choices.text: I'm not sure you know either, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, come on!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup! Whatever the case, we can see The Alcor from here. Let's take a photo of Kichiboushi!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Photo! Drawing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, that's right! Alright, stand still for a moment now!

choices.text: It's fine if you don't get it yet.
You can get by without understanding some things.
Ships can float as long as their buoyancy exceeds the pull of gravity.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, is that how it is? Paimon gets it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Next, let's bring Kichiboushi onboard The Alcor!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Not good. If boat sinks...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Relax, this boat won't sink.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This ship took us all the way to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Exactly! And that's how we came to meet you and Ioroi. So don't worry, it'll be fine!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm! Understood.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Captain Beidou is a real steady hand, and so are the rest of her crew. Basically, this ship is the safest place on the high seas!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm! Yey!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See! The view's great, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm! Very good!

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Many mountains over there. What place is that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? Well...

choices.text: That's Inazuma.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. That should be Mt. Yougou over there — and beneath it? That's where Chinju Forest is.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: So far. Ioroi, across the sea.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. But we'll be with you all the way!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well then, where to next...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is there somewhere familiar where we can find some good food?

choices.text: Of course it's about food with you, Paimon.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Good food, good idea!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Aw! See, {NICKNAME}? Kichiboushi knows what's up. Eating all the good food in the world is good training too, you know?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kichiboushi will surpass you pretty quick if you don't wise up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right? Climbing the mast sure was tiring.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: White Fur climb? But White Fur can fly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, details!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whatever the case, we'll stop here today. Paimon's gotta have a good think about where we'll go next.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm!

choices.text: Guess it's just as well that I'm feeling a little peckish.
That's where you're from.

dialogues.speaker: Ioroi
dialogues.text: Take this child to see the outside world. That which I cannot do myself, I leave to you.

dialogues.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
dialogues.text: Mm! Training is fun!

choices.text: As long as you're having fun.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Yellow Fur very strong. Kapow — big and round thing gone.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's because I train regularly, you know?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm! Kichiboushi, become strong like Yellow Fur!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Train, train, and train. Strong-strong!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What do you plan to do once you become stronger, Kichiboushi?

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Get back at Gyoubu Koban, mmhaha!

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Then make Ioroi not stone.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Good luck. As for your training route, just leave it to us.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Mm!

choices.text: Let's have fun then. See you later.

response.speaker: "Kichiboushi"
response.text: Yey!
